data.summary: The contractor's reputation is mixed. The Google reviews appear highly suspicious due to their low count, generic content, and perfect rating, which contrasts sharply with the more established and moderate ratings on Yelp and Houzz. The Yelp and Houzz profiles suggest a real business with a decent, but not flawless, reputation. The Google profile may have been manipulated or is not a primary review platform for this business.
fake_signals: Google reviews are extremely generic and lack detail
Two Google reviews have no text content
Google reviews all posted within the same 5-month window
Low review volume on Google (4) vs. Yelp (19) and Houzz (25) suggests potential review seeding on Google
authentic_signals: Yelp rating of 3.9 with 19 reviews suggests a more realistic customer spread
Houzz rating of 4.8 with 25 reviews indicates a solid professional reputation
Yelp platform typically has more organic, detailed reviews
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant discrepancy between a perfect 5.0 on Google (4 reviews) and a more moderate 3.9 on Yelp (19 reviews). The Google reviews are extremely sparse and lack detail, while Yelp has a larger, more established review base.
